core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace, Sheerness – Guide Price £150,000
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness, for sale by Modern Method of Auction with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation and offers a rear yard, gas central heating and on-street parking.

The ground floor comprises a reception room. The first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Outside is a rear yard. On-street parking is available without a permit.

Station Terrace is in Sheerness.

For sale by Modern Method of Auction at a guide price of £150,000, freehold, with no onward chain. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. The buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide.
